selection.method: Source-only selection from current public Google/GoogleCloudPlatform and independent Google ADK repositories after canonical depth-parity closure. No HorusTrace output from this cohort was used to select cases. Every target is pinned to an exact commit SHA and scanned at an application-level path.
selection.interpretation: Fresh unseen Google ADK Python holdout to test whether canonical depth semantics generalize to repository composition, helper factories, custom BaseAgent implementations, skills, MCP, callbacks/plugins, data stores and multi-agent delegation.

cases.source_signal: ADK v2 LlmAgent is returned by create_security_agent(), exposed as root_agent, and receives a helper-built list of conditional stdio MCP toolsets plus a before-model callback. Tests cross-file factory/toolset resolution without executing settings-dependent code.

Planner root is returned by get_agent(), binds helper-built SkillToolset/PreloadMemory/FunctionTool and dynamically discovered Agent Registry MCP tools, uses a financial guardrail callback, and is exposed through A2A deployment.

Source-defined RiskGuardAgent subclasses ADK BaseAgent and implements _run_async_impl for an A2A-hosted risk decision workflow. Tests custom BaseAgent principal recognition without inventing model-callable tools.

Coordinator LlmAgent imports two repository-local specialist agents, delegates through sub_agents, with one specialist backed by Streamable HTTP MCP and another using a database toolbox client. Tests cross-file delegation and specialist authority propagation.

Direct ADK Agent binds plain functions that perform MongoDB vector reads, cart reads and update_one(upsert=True) persistent mutation. Tests source-over-name data read/write inference and database authority.

HR coordinator uses a before-agent state callback, multiple repository-local onboarding tools and an IT provisioning subagent. Tests cross-file tool effects, callback classification and delegated mutation authority.

Async factory creates root LlmAgent plus two specialist subagents; specialists receive three inline stdio MCPToolsets for Airbnb, weather and cocktail servers. Tests factory-returned multi-agent roots, inline MCP construction and delegated MCP authority.

Production-style Red Hat Lightspeed LlmAgent uses ADK SkillToolset and helper-built MCP authority with stdio/SSE/HTTP transport selected from runtime configuration, dynamic auth header provider and large explicit tool filters. Tests dynamic MCP preservation and skills composition.

Agent-builder app combines SkillToolset, stdio ADK docs MCP, AgentTool delegation to an UnsafeLocalCodeExecutor child, and local file/process tools. Tests high-authority composition and delegated local execution.

Async create_host_agent() constructs an ADK Agent after runtime A2A specialist discovery and binds a repository-local delegate tool that calls discovered specialist endpoints. Tests factory-returned async roots and dynamic delegation authority without inventing a specialist catalogue.
